description: This file is a shell script used for testing git diff context and related operations. It includes functions for setting up test scenarios, creating commits and tags, and checking diff contexts, specifically focusing on how diffs are generated and applied in various complex scenarios.

methods.name: commit_and_tag
methods.description: Creates a git commit with the specified tag and files.

methods.name: first_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the first line of context from diff output.

methods.name: last_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the last line of context from diff output.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff for a file and verifies if it can be applied correctly.
